Flow 4: Fill-in

A snippet with blanks asks for them in a small form, right where the user is typing. The form opens instantly, is driven entirely from the keyboard, remembers the last answers, and gives the focus back to the app before a single character is typed. Cancelling changes nothing.

Form visible under 150 ms after the trigger Acknowledged to the service within 2 s, or the expansion is abandoned Answers remembered 30 minutes, in memory only
